body_text:
A bounded function $f:[a,b]\to\mathbb{R}$ is Riemann integrable
if for every $\epsilon>0$ there is a partition $P$ such that
$U(f,P)-L(f,P)<\epsilon$. The common value of the supremum of
all lower sums and the infimum of all upper sums is denoted
$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx$.
